name: find_drugs_for_disease
description: Retrieve a list of drugs associated with a specific disease. Use this tool when you need to identify potential treatments or medications for a given disease. Do NOT use this tool for general drug information or drug interactions; for those purposes, consider using 'get_drug_info' or 'search_drug_interactions'.

parameters.name: disease_name
parameters.description: The name of the disease for which to find associated drugs. Should be a complete disease name (e.g. 'diabetes mellitus', 'hypertension'). No special characters or abbreviations. Required.

parameters.name: include_off_label
parameters.description: Whether to include drugs that are used off-label for the disease. Set to true to include these drugs; defaults to false.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of drugs to return. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

drugs.description: List of drugs associated with the specified disease. Each item includes: drug_name (string), drug_class (string), and indication (string).

total_count.description: Total number of drugs found for the disease, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object containing a list of drugs and the total count of drugs found.
